blocks.text: Śiva Sūtras 3.12
blocks.directed: [long pause] Śiva Sūtras 3.12

blocks.text: धीवशात्सत्त्वसिद्धिः
blocks.directed: [slowly] धीवशात्सत्त्वसिद्धिः

blocks.text: Dhīvaśāt sattvasiddhiḥ.
blocks.directed: Dhīvaśāt sattvasiddhiḥ.

blocks.text: Through refined understanding, the subtle reality of inner consciousness becomes manifest.
blocks.directed: Through refined understanding, the subtle reality of inner consciousness becomes manifest.

blocks.text: Use Your Bloody Intelligence, but the Proper Kind This Time.
blocks.directed: Use Your Bloody Intelligence, but the Proper Kind This Time.

blocks.text: Now this is a beautiful statement.
blocks.directed: Now this is a beautiful statement.

blocks.text: Because we’ve spent so much time discussing how limited knowledge contributes to bondage that you might imagine Trika regards intelligence as something fundamentally suspicious.
blocks.directed: Because we’ve spent so much time discussing how limited knowledge contributes to bondage that you might imagine Trika regards intelligence as something fundamentally suspicious.

blocks.text: But no.
blocks.directed: But no.

blocks.text: Vasugupta is not advocating stupidity.
blocks.directed: Vasugupta is not advocating stupidity.

blocks.text: Thank goodness.
blocks.directed: [short pause] Thank goodness.

blocks.text: Sanskrit studies may continue.
blocks.directed: Sanskrit studies may continue.

blocks.text: Let’s unpack the words.
blocks.directed: Let’s unpack the words.

blocks.text: Dhī — intelligence, insight, understanding.
blocks.directed: Dhī — intelligence, insight, understanding.

blocks.text: Vaśāt — through the power of, by virtue of.
blocks.directed: Vaśāt — through the power of, by virtue of.

blocks.text: Sattva — being, essential reality; here interpreted by Kṣemarāja in a particular yogic sense.
blocks.directed: Sattva — being, essential reality; here interpreted by Kṣemarāja in a particular yogic sense.

blocks.text: Siddhi — accomplishment, attainment, manifestation.
blocks.directed: Siddhi — accomplishment, attainment, manifestation.

blocks.text: And we need to be particularly careful with sattva.
blocks.directed: And we need to be particularly careful with sattva.

blocks.text: Because you may know sattva as one of the three guṇas.
blocks.directed: Because you may know sattva as one of the three guṇas.

blocks.text: Sattva, rajas and tamas.
blocks.directed: Sattva, rajas and tamas.

blocks.text: Clarity, activity and inertia.
blocks.directed: Clarity, activity and inertia.

blocks.text: But that is not Kṣemarāja’s intended sense here.
blocks.directed: But that is not Kṣemarāja’s intended sense here.

blocks.text: He interprets sattva as the subtle inner reality characterised by sphurattā — the luminous flashing forth of I-consciousness — and parispanda, subtle inner pulsation.
blocks.directed: He interprets sattva as the subtle inner reality characterised by sphurattā — the luminous flashing forth of I-consciousness — and parispanda, subtle inner pulsation.

blocks.text: Now this is quite something.
blocks.directed: Now this is quite something.

blocks.text: Because it means dhī isn’t simply the ordinary intellect collecting facts.
blocks.directed: Because it means dhī isn’t simply the ordinary intellect collecting facts.

blocks.text: It’s an understanding capable of discerning the actual nature of the Self.
blocks.directed: It’s an understanding capable of discerning the actual nature of the Self.

blocks.text: Kṣemarāja specifically defines this intelligence through skill in contemplating or recognising tāttvikasvarūpa — one’s essential reality.
blocks.directed: Kṣemarāja specifically defines this intelligence through skill in contemplating or recognising tāttvikasvarūpa — one’s essential reality.

blocks.text: And through that refined understanding, the subtle inner reality becomes manifest.
blocks.directed: And through that refined understanding, the subtle inner reality becomes manifest.

blocks.text: Now let’s connect this to the theatre analogy.
blocks.directed: Now let’s connect this to the theatre analogy.

blocks.text: An actor may possess tremendous technical skill.
blocks.directed: An actor may possess tremendous technical skill.

blocks.text: They understand timing.
blocks.directed: They understand timing.

blocks.text: Movement.
blocks.directed: Movement.

blocks.text: Expression.
blocks.directed: Expression.

blocks.text: The emotional structure of a performance.
blocks.directed: The emotional structure of a performance.

blocks.text: They know how to bring a particular inner feeling into visible expression.
blocks.directed: They know how to bring a particular inner feeling into visible expression.

blocks.text: And Kṣemarāja actually invokes this kind of theatrical expertise.
blocks.directed: And Kṣemarāja actually invokes this kind of theatrical expertise.

blocks.text: Just as refined intelligence enables accomplished dramatic expression, spiritual intelligence enables recognition of the subtle inner reality of consciousness.
blocks.directed: Just as refined intelligence enables accomplished dramatic expression, spiritual intelligence enables recognition of the subtle inner reality of consciousness.

blocks.text: It’s an unusual but extraordinarily elegant comparison. Sanskrit & Trika Shaivism.
blocks.directed: It’s an unusual but extraordinarily elegant comparison. Sanskrit & Trika Shaivism.

blocks.text: And it has a deep philosophical implication.
blocks.directed: And it has a deep philosophical implication.

blocks.text: Understanding isn’t necessarily an obstacle.
blocks.directed: Understanding isn’t necessarily an obstacle.

blocks.text: Misunderstanding is.
blocks.directed: Misunderstanding is.

blocks.text: A conceptual structure that reinforces the independence of the limited individual can sustain bondage.
blocks.directed: A conceptual structure that reinforces the independence of the limited individual can sustain bondage.

blocks.text: But an understanding that discloses the universal nature of consciousness can participate in liberation.
blocks.directed: But an understanding that discloses the universal nature of consciousness can participate in liberation.

blocks.text: Remember our encounter with:
blocks.directed: [short pause] Remember our encounter with:

blocks.text: वितर्क आत्मज्ञानम्।
blocks.directed: [slowly] वितर्क आत्मज्ञानम्।

blocks.text: Vitarka ātmajñānam.
blocks.directed: Vitarka ātmajñānam.

blocks.text: Reflective ascertainment is Self-knowledge.
blocks.directed: Reflective ascertainment is Self-knowledge.

blocks.text: The same general principle returns.
blocks.directed: The same general principle returns.

blocks.text: It’s not merely the presence or absence of thought that matters.
blocks.directed: It’s not merely the presence or absence of thought that matters.

blocks.text: It’s the relation of thought to recognition.
blocks.directed: It’s the relation of thought to recognition.

blocks.text: Now, this is especially important for anyone studying Trika through philosophical analysis.
blocks.directed: Now, this is especially important for anyone studying Trika through philosophical analysis.

blocks.text: You can investigate the structure of experience.
blocks.directed: You can investigate the structure of experience.

blocks.text: Examine the distinction between perceiver and perceived.
blocks.directed: Examine the distinction between perceiver and perceived.

blocks.text: Study the relation between prakāśa and vimarśa.
blocks.directed: Study the relation between prakāśa and vimarśa.

blocks.text: Consider how limited identity arises through saṃkoca.
blocks.directed: Consider how limited identity arises through saṃkoca.

blocks.text: And these investigations can help clarify what the tradition is pointing towards.
blocks.directed: And these investigations can help clarify what the tradition is pointing towards.

blocks.text: But the aim isn’t merely to accumulate an increasingly elaborate conceptual representation of consciousness.
blocks.directed: But the aim isn’t merely to accumulate an increasingly elaborate conceptual representation of consciousness.

blocks.text: It’s to understand the conscious reality in which those representations themselves arise.
blocks.directed: It’s to understand the conscious reality in which those representations themselves arise.

blocks.text: Imagine a man building an extraordinarily accurate map of the ocean.
blocks.directed: Imagine a man building an extraordinarily accurate map of the ocean.

blocks.text: He’s got currents.
blocks.directed: He’s got currents.

blocks.text: Depths.
blocks.directed: Depths.

blocks.text: Salinity.
blocks.directed: Salinity.

blocks.text: Tides.
blocks.directed: Tides.

blocks.text: Every conceivable measurement.
blocks.directed: Every conceivable measurement.

blocks.text: Absolutely magnificent cartography.
blocks.directed: Absolutely magnificent cartography.

blocks.text: But he’s forgotten that he’s standing in water.
blocks.directed: But he’s forgotten that he’s standing in water.

blocks.text: At some point, a different kind of recognition is required.
blocks.directed: At some point, a different kind of recognition is required.

blocks.text: The map is useful.
blocks.directed: The map is useful.

blocks.text: But the map is not the ocean.
blocks.directed: But the map is not the ocean.

blocks.text: And the understanding of consciousness is not identical to the direct recognition of consciousness.
blocks.directed: And the understanding of consciousness is not identical to the direct recognition of consciousness.

blocks.text: Still, the map can direct the investigation.
blocks.directed: Still, the map can direct the investigation.

blocks.text: And that’s the role of refined intelligence here.
blocks.directed: And that’s the role of refined intelligence here.

blocks.text: Dhī becomes an instrument of disclosure.
blocks.directed: Dhī becomes an instrument of disclosure.

blocks.text: The apparent limitation of cognition is transformed into a means of recognising its source.
blocks.directed: The apparent limitation of cognition is transformed into a means of recognising its source.

blocks.text: And now Vasugupta gives us the result.
blocks.directed: And now Vasugupta gives us the result.

blocks.text: A word we’ve been circling around since the first sūtra.
blocks.directed: A word we’ve been circling around since the first sūtra.

blocks.text: Svātantrya.
blocks.directed: [slowly] Svātantrya.

blocks.text: Freedom.
blocks.directed: Freedom.

blocks.text: Absolute freedom.
blocks.directed: Absolute freedom.

blocks.text: And this is one of the most beautiful statements in the text.
blocks.directed: And this is one of the most beautiful statements in the text.
